name: Soybean Crush Spread
description: Soybean processing margin (crush spread) using the standard CBOT board crush formula: (ZM×44/2000) + (ZL×11/100) − (ZS/100). Shows the crush spread level with 50-day and 200-day moving averages for trend context, a 252-day z-score for historical positioning, and event markers when the z-score hits ±2σ extremes.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush Formula
# Crush = (ZM × 44/2000) + (ZL × 11/100) − (ZS / 100)
# ZM: soybean meal, $/short ton | ZL: soybean oil, cents/lb | ZS: soybeans, cents/bu
# Result in $/bushel of soybeans processed

# --- Data: Load all three soybean complex futures ---
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()

# Build continuations — NoAdjustment for level-based spread calculation
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# Meal revenue: ZM ($/short ton) × 44 lbs / 2000 lbs per ton
meal_revenue = zm.c * 44.0 / 2000.0
# Oil revenue: ZL (cents/lb) × 11 lbs / 100 cents per dollar
oil_revenue = zl.c * 11.0 / 100.0
# Bean cost: ZS (cents/bu) / 100 cents per dollar
bean_cost = zs.c / 100.0

crush_spread = meal_revenue + oil_revenue - bean_cost

# --- Trend Context ---
crush_ma50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(crush_spread)
crush_ma200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(crush_spread)

# --- Z-Score: Is the crush margin historically high or low? ---
crush_z = zscore(window=252)(crush_spread)

# --- Extreme Detection for Event Markers ---
# Z-score crosses above +2 (margin expansion extreme)
z_high = crush_z > 2.0
z_cross_high = crossover(crush_z, 2.0)
# Z-score crosses below -2 (margin compression extreme)
z_low = crush_z < -2.0
z_cross_low = crossunder(crush_z, -2.0)
# Any extreme event
is_extreme = z_cross_high or z_cross_low
extreme_label = "High Margin" if z_cross_high else ("Low Margin" if z_cross_low else "")

ts = index().value

# --- Chart 1: Crush Spread Level with Moving Averages ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Spread — Where Is the Processing Margin?',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='Crush Spread',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='50d MA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='200d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.LongDash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_spread, crush_ma50, crush_ma200))

# --- Chart 2: Z-Score — Is the Margin Historically Rich or Cheap? ---
xy_lines(
    title='Crush Margin Z-Score — Rich or Cheap vs 1-Year History?',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (252d)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category='Crush Spread',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Average'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='+2σ (Rich)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='-2σ (Cheap)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=2.0, to=4.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.08, label='Rich'),
        PlotBand(from=-4.0, to=-2.0, color=Color.Green, opacity=0.08, label='Cheap')
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(crush_z,))

# --- Summary Table: Key Crush Spread Statistics ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Statistics ($/bushel)',
        row_size=3, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Current', 'Historical', 'Extremes'],
        col_headers=['Metric', 'Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Latest crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1, info='Latest 252d z-score'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Median crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Mean crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Lowest crush spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, info='Highest crush spread')
        ]
    ),
    category='Crush Spread',
    order=3
)(crush_spread, crush_z, crush_spread, crush_spread, crush_spread, crush_spread)

# --- Event Markers: Extreme Z-Score Events ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crush Margin Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Meal Revenue', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='Oil Revenue', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(title='Bean Cost', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(extreme_label, crush_z, crush_spread, meal_revenue, oil_revenue, bean_cost, is_extreme)
